'''Saccorata''' was a large [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the main continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]], about five hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from [[Dorthus Tal Island]]. The [[Sacorria Central Spaceport]] was located on the outskirts of the city.
